name: imference-mcp

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Overview of the generation models, made for PICKING the right one for the need: kind (image or video; kind image-edit lists the instruction-edit models of edit_with_instructions instead), style/family, one-line description, cost in credits (1 credit = $0.001), and capabilities (img2img, audio). Once a model is chosen, call get_model for its full description, recommended prompting and exact parameter bounds before generating.

kind.description: Filter by kind (default: image + video, the generation models). image-edit = the instruction-edit models for edit_with_instructions; all = everything.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Everything about one model before generating with it: full description, how to prompt it (style and recommended prompt prefix), the exact parameters it accepts with bounds and defaults (the same list the API validates against — anything else is refused with a 400), its output formats with price multipliers, and its capabilities.

tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: List the predefined output formats per model: format_code (e.g. 'square', 'portrait', 'landscape-wide'), its resolution/ratio, and its price multiplier (credit_multiplier — HD tiers bill more). Pass a format_code to generate to pick a size; each model has a default.

model.description: Filter formats for a single model_code

tools.name: list_loras
tools.description: List the curated LoRAs (add-ons that push a style, character or effect on top of a model) with their pre-tuned weights and trigger words. LoRAs are OPT-IN: only use one when the user explicitly asks for a LoRA, or for a specific style / character / effect they want added that the model can't do on its own. A LoRA strongly changes the output (some are deliberately lo-fi or stylized), so never add one on your own initiative to 'improve' an image — if one looks relevant, SUGGEST it to the user and wait for their go-ahead. Don't call this before every generation — only when LoRAs are in play. Pass model to keep the ones that go on that model (a LoRA only works on its compatible families).

model.description: Only the LoRAs compatible with this model_code

category.description: Filter by category: style, character, concept, clothing, pose, detail, other

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Generate an image or video and wait for the result — on this computer's GPU with Imference Desktop (free, run_on), or in the Imference cloud. The media kind (image or video) is determined by the model — use list_models to pick a model_code, and get_model to learn how to prompt it and which parameters it accepts. Size and aspect ratio are chosen with format_code (a predefined format from list_formats), never with raw dimensions. Payment: either the credits rail (Imference key balance) or the x402 rail (pay-per-generation in USDC on Base, signed with the configured wallet); defaults to credits when an Imference key is set, else x402 when a wallet is set. Returns the media URL when done; if the generation is still running after wait_seconds, returns the request_id so you can poll with check_status. run_on 'auto' (default) generates locally when Imference Desktop is running and has the model downloaded (list_models shows `local`), else in the cloud; a local failure is reported, never silently retried as a paid cloud run. The result's `ran` says where it ran: always tell the user (local = on their computer, free; cloud = paid, with the credits spent).

run_on.description: Where to generate: 'local' = Imference Desktop on this computer (free; the model must be downloaded in Desktop; LoRAs, batches and video knobs are cloud-only), 'cloud' = the Imference cloud (paid), 'auto' (default) = local when Desktop can, else cloud.

rail.description: Payment rail: 'credits' (Imference key balance) or 'x402' (per-request USDC payment on Base). Default: credits if an Imference key is configured, else x402.

model.description: Model code from list_models. Required in the cloud; locally, omitted = the model selected in Imference Desktop.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired output

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid (model default if omitted)

format_code.description: Output size/ratio as a predefined format code from list_formats, e.g. 'square', 'portrait', 'landscape-wide' (model's default format if omitted). This is the ONLY way to pick a size or aspect ratio — raw dimensions are not accepted. Some formats (HD tiers) multiply the price; list_formats shows each one's credit_multiplier.

batch_nbr.description: Number of images to generate in one request (default 1, max 4). Each image is billed. Note: the status result carries the first image only — fetch the rest with list_media.

img_url.description: Source image — for img2img on image models, or image-to-video on video models. An https URL; local runs also take a file path (e.g. a previous local output) or a data: URI.

weight.description: Strength within the LoRA's weight bounds (its default if omitted)

loras.description: OMIT unless the user asked for it. Curated LoRAs to stack on the model (codes from list_loras, compatible with the model; same price). LoRAs are OPT-IN: only use one when the user explicitly asks for a LoRA, or for a specific style / character / effect they want added that the model can't do on its own. A LoRA strongly changes the output (some are deliberately lo-fi or stylized), so never add one on your own initiative to 'improve' an image — if one looks relevant, SUGGEST it to the user and wait for their go-ahead.

duration_s.description: Video only: clip length in seconds, for models whose duration_s in list_models says the knob exists. Billed proportionally to the model's default duration (a 10s clip on a 5s-default model costs ×2).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for completion before returning the request_id to poll with check_status (default 50 — MCP clients give up on a tool call after ~60s; 0 = return immediately)

include_image.description: Embed the finished image in the result so you can see it (default true; images ≤ 3MB only, never videos)

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Check the status of a previously submitted generation or editing-tool run. Returns the media URL (tools: every output, plus the text of describe_image) when done, 'pending' while still running, or the failure reason. A local run (request_id local_…, still running in Imference Desktop) is waited for up to wait_seconds, then its file path is returned.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by generate or an editing tool

wait_seconds.description: Local runs (local_…): how long to wait for the end (default 50)

include_image.description: Embed the finished image in the result (default true; images ≤ 3MB only)

tools.name: download_media
tools.description: Download a generated image or video to a local file. Pass either the media URL (from generate / check_status / list_media) or a request_id of a finished generation.

request_id.description: Alternatively, the request_id of a finished generation

output_path.description: Destination file path (parent directories are created)

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the remaining credit balance of the configured Imference key (1 credit = $0.001). Compare with a model's cost_credits from list_models before generating.

tools.name: payment_config
tools.description: Show which payment rails this server can use: credits (an Imference key, IMFERENCE_API_KEY) and/or x402 (wallet paying USDC on Base), plus the spending caps and what has been spent so far. Returns the wallet's public address when configured — fund it with USDC on Base mainnet to enable x402 payments. Never exposes key material.

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: Read the configured wallet's USDC balance on Base mainnet (read-only RPC call). Use it to check the wallet can cover a generation before paying. x402 payments are gasless for the payer — only USDC is needed, no ETH.

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: List all images and videos previously generated with the configured Imference key, newest first.

tools.name: list_history
tools.description: List past calls (generations and editing tools), newest first, for the Imference key (credits rail) or the configured wallet (x402 rail, signed in automatically, no payment). Each call has its status, rail, kind, credits charged and its outputs. Prompts and settings are never stored, so they are not listed. Output URLs are given for 24 h: pass one to download_media to fetch the file again; after that the call shows expired: true and no URL.

rail.description: Whose calls: the Imference key's (credits) or the wallet's (x402). Default: credits when an Imference key is set, else x402

since.description: Only calls at or after this RFC 3339 time

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the image/video editing tools (remove background, upscale, describe, outpaint, crop, convert, video trim/join...) with their price per cloud run (1 credit = $0.001), whether each runs in the cloud and/or locally in Imference Desktop (free), and whether Desktop is running right now. Each tool is also its own MCP tool (the `tool` name).

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert to PNG, JPEG or WebP and set the compression quality. Runs locally in Imference Desktop (free; cpu/cuda/mps/rocm/directml) or in the cloud; run_on 'auto' (default) uses Desktop when it is running, else the cloud. Price in the cloud: 1 credit ($0.001) per run. Free when run locally. Returns: image (image).

image.description: Source image (image). A local file path, an https URL or a data: URI. Limits: ≤ 30 MB, ≤ 40 MP.

max_kb.description: Lower the quality until the file fits (JPEG/WebP). Optional.

background.description: Fill for transparent pixels when the format has no alpha (JPEG). Default: '#ffffff'.

run_on.description: Where to run: 'local' = Imference Desktop on this computer (free, files stay local), 'cloud' = Imference API (paid), 'auto' (default) = local when Desktop is running and can run this tool, else cloud. With 'auto', a local out-of-memory / unsupported-hardware failure is retried in the cloud and the result says so.

wait_seconds.description: Cloud runs: how long to wait for the result before returning the request_id for check_status (default 50, 0 = return immediately; local runs too).

rail.description: Cloud payment rail: 'credits' (Imference key balance) or 'x402' (per-run USDC payment on Base). Default: credits if an Imference key is configured, else x402.

include_image.description: Embed image outputs in the result so you can see them (default true; ≤ 3 MB, never videos).

tools.name: edit_with_instructions
tools.description: Edit an image by describing the change in plain words (Qwen-Image-Edit): change the background, add or remove objects, restyle, fix text. Optional reference images. Write `instruction` as one plain, specific edit, e.g. "replace the background with a beach at sunset", "remove the person on the left", "change the text on the sign to OPEN", "make it a watercolor painting". Everything not mentioned is kept. Optional `references` (up to 2 images) are referred to in the instruction as image 2 and image 3 (the edited `image` is image 1), e.g. "put the hat from image 2 on the man". To remove an object use erase_object; for a new image from scratch use generate. Uses an instruction-edit model: `model` defaults to 'qwen-image-edit-2511' (other edit models: list_models entries marked edit_model / engine 'qwenimage-edit'). Runs in the cloud on that model's workers; locally only when Imference Desktop reports it available (GPU). Price in the cloud: the selected model's generation price (see get_model / list_models). Free when run locally. Returns: image (image).

image.description: Image to edit (image). A local file path, an https URL or a data: URI. Limits: ≤ 30 MB, ≤ 4 MP.

references.description: Optional reference images (image 2, image 3 in the instruction) (image). A list of local file paths, https URLs or data: URIs, in order. Limits: ≤ 30 MB, ≤ 4 MP, 1–2 items.

model.description: An instruction-edit model (catalog models with engine qwenimage-edit, e.g. qwen-image-edit-2511). Default: 'qwen-image-edit-2511'.

instruction.description: The change to make, e.g. "replace the sky with a sunset". Required.

steps.description: Denoising steps (default: the model's recipe, 4 for the Lightning build of qwen-image-edit-2511). Optional.

guidance.description: True CFG scale (default: the model's recipe, 1.0 for the Lightning build). Optional.

keep_size.description: Resize the result back to the input size (the model works at 0.5 to 1 MP: a small input is rendered at its own size, at least 0.5 MP). Default: true.

seed.description: Fixed seed for a reproducible result (default: random). Optional.

run_on.description: Where to run: 'local' = Imference Desktop on this computer (free, files stay local), 'cloud' = Imference API (paid), 'auto' (default) = local when Desktop is running and can run this tool, else cloud. With 'auto', a local out-of-memory / unsupported-hardware failure is retried in the cloud and the result says so.

tools.name: vary_image
tools.description: Make a variation of an image with a generation model (img2img). Subtle keeps the composition, strong reimagines it. Needs a generation model: pass `model` (a model_code from list_models that accepts an image input). Runs in the cloud on that model's workers; locally only when Imference Desktop reports it available (GPU). Price in the cloud: the selected model's generation price (see get_model / list_models).
